official_sources.title: GDAL Raster Data Model
official_sources.finding: Raster bands carry datatype, NoData, scale, offset, units and overview semantics; raw storage type and derived display/overview layers must be distinguished before numeric elevation use.
official_sources.limitation: Generic library semantics; the target raster still needs runtime metadata readback.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand class reference
official_sources.finding: GetNoDataValue returns raw NoData, RasterIO/ReadBlock do not apply scale/offset automatically, and exact ComputeRasterMinMax requires approximate mode disabled and all pixels read.
official_sources.limitation: API semantics do not prove the target dataset values until the actual band is read.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdalinfo
official_sources.finding: -mm forces actual band min/max computation, while approximate statistics may use overviews or subsets; exact extrema validation must avoid approximate statistics.
official_sources.limitation: Whole-band extrema are a tool check; parcel-mask extrema still require exact target masking.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster info
official_sources.finding: The modern raster-info command can compute min/max and statistics using all pixels, providing a second explicit full-resolution metadata/statistics check.
official_sources.limitation: Parcel-specific selection still requires the canonical boundary and mask.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal_translate
official_sources.finding: -unscale applies raw*scale+offset; -a_scale/-a_offset only attach metadata; -srcwin outside bounds may synthesize zero/NoData unless error-on-partial/outside options are used.
official_sources.limitation: Conversion commands are derived operations and cannot silently replace the immutable source raster.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster unscale
official_sources.finding: Unscale explicitly applies band scale/offset; many integer/Float32 inputs default to Float32 output, so output datatype must be recorded when decoding packed elevation values.
official_sources.limitation: Default Float32 output may be adequate for many datasets but cannot be assumed to preserve every source precision requirement.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 15 Band Masks
official_sources.finding: Validity can come from .msk, NoData-derived masks, alpha masks or all-valid fallback; mask origin and flags must be explicit before excluding pixels.
official_sources.limitation: Generic mask hierarchy; target raster may also carry provider-specific validity conventions.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL GeoTIFF driver
official_sources.finding: GeoTIFF can store internal transparency masks and expose them as promoted validity values; internal mask presence must be included in source-file provenance.
official_sources.limitation: Driver behavior does not determine whether the EA target file actually has an internal mask.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL VRT driver
official_sources.finding: VRT ComplexSource can rescale, offset, mask and map source rectangles to destination rectangles; VRT values may therefore be derived rather than native source samples.
official_sources.limitation: VRT is useful for audit and mosaics but should not silently define terminal native extrema.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal_calc
official_sources.finding: Input NoData is excluded by default, and intermediate arithmetic with same-type operands can retain the original datatype despite requested output type; arithmetic dtype must be pinned.
official_sources.limitation: Raster algebra is a derived path; native extrema should be decoded before arithmetic.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster footprint
official_sources.finding: Raster footprint derives valid-data geometry from intrinsic masks or NoData and can record input location, providing an independent validity-boundary audit.
official_sources.limitation: Footprint polygons are derived QA geometry, not the canonical parcel boundary.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 58 Removing Dataset NoData
official_sources.finding: NoData metadata can be removed or changed, and some drivers rely on PAM sidecars; source NoData semantics must be captured before any conversion.
official_sources.limitation: Historical files may expose NoData through different mechanisms depending on driver/version.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster fill-nodata
official_sources.finding: Fill-nodata interpolates invalid areas using inverse-distance or nearest strategies; filled cells are derived and must not silently become native parcel extrema.
official_sources.limitation: Interpolated fill may be useful for visualization or secondary QA, not native terminal elevation evidence.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster mosaic
official_sources.finding: Mosaic can change resolution, align pixels, override NoData and apply pixel functions over overlaps; mosaic construction choices must be logged and kept separate from native-tile extrema.
official_sources.limitation: Mosaic output is derived even when source pixels are lossless copies.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL Multidimensional Raster Data Model
official_sources.finding: Multidimensional arrays also carry NoData, unit, scale and offset where unscaled value=offset+scale*raw; the same packed-value provenance rule applies across raster APIs.
official_sources.limitation: Target EA DTM is expected as conventional raster; this is a cross-API consistency guard.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster overview refresh
official_sources.finding: Overview pixels are downsampled with selectable resampling; overview statistics or samples are not interchangeable with full-resolution native extrema.
official_sources.limitation: Overviews remain useful for display and approximate checks only.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: gdal raster reproject
official_sources.finding: Reprojection may use source overviews during downsampling and the overview's creation resampling may differ from the requested runtime resampling; terminal native-value paths must avoid hidden overview reuse.
official_sources.limitation: Reprojection is a derived operation; target processing should bind native CRS when possible.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL COG driver
official_sources.finding: COG creation can generate overviews, preprocess data and use lossy compression such as JPEG; full-resolution elevation provenance must record compression/overview behavior and prefer lossless numeric storage.
official_sources.limitation: COG container semantics alone do not imply that a particular EA elevation file is lossy.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public GDAL/OSGeo documentation; publisher terms apply
